examples.en: I lost one earring.
These earrings are silver.

note: Mostly used in the plural.

examples.en: Cook the soup in a big pot.
Every pot finds its lid.
The First Serbian Uprising began in 1804.
The uprising was crushed within a few days.

related.en: to get up, to rise up

examples.en: Yoga helps us open all the chakras.
Every chakra has its own color.
Today is election day.
I'm choosing an elective in music.

note: «изборни предмет» - an elective (school subject)

examples.en: She has a light complexion.
This cream gives a healthy complexion.
The picture is out of focus.
The camera can't find the focus.
Mom is heating up the soup on the stove.
The sun is warming the sea.
We bought a new mattress for the bed.
This mattress is too hard.
His brother is a big gambler.
The gambler lost his entire salary.
I need a nasal spray.
Take the mosquito spray.
He gave me his business card.
Do you have a business card?
There are two monitors on the desk.
We bought a new monitor.
There is a strong faction of opponents in the party.
The factions are fighting for power.
He writes a weekly column for the newspaper.
His column provoked stormy reactions.

note: A newspaper column, not an architectural one (that is «стуб»).

examples.en: In the story, a goblin guards a treasure.
Goblins live in caves.
We sleep in the guest room.
The team is playing an away game.
Subtract three from ten.
The child is learning to subtract.
The red line marks the border.
What does this word mean?
The shop window has a big selection of rings.
The website has a section for rings.

note: Collective noun, neuter singular; one ring is «прстен».

examples.sr: Морам да [одлѐжим] два дана у кревету.
examples.en: I have to stay in bed for two days.
The meat sat in the fridge for a while.

examples.sr: Било ми је [му̏чно] да то гледам.
examples.en: It made me sick to watch it.
I get carsick.

note: «мучно ми је» - I feel sick

examples.en: Lobster is an expensive delicacy.
We had lobster for dinner on the coast.
This isn't real leather, it's an imitation.
His imitation of her voice was perfect.
The final deadline for applications is Friday.
That's the last stop.

note: Means extreme, at the very edge; «последњи» is simply the one that comes last.

examples.en: He smiled mysteriously.
The door opened mysteriously.
Transferring the data takes a long time.
The redeployment of troops began this morning.

examples.sr: Реч селфи била је некада нова [кова̀ница].
examples.en: The word 'selfie' was once a new coinage.
That new word spread quickly.

related.en: to forge, to mint, to coin

examples.en: He's still single.
He lives as a bachelor in a small apartment.
The series has a high rating.
The president's rating has dropped.
The sheikh came for a visit.
Rich sheikhs build skyscrapers.
The police threw tear gas at the demonstrators.
The tear gas made our eyes water.
The child committed a minor offense.
This violation is punishable.
I got gold earrings for my birthday.
One of my earrings fell off.

note: Not earphones - those are «слушалице».

examples.en: May every day of yours be blessed.
This is a blessed place.
The analyst tracks price movements.
The bank is looking for an experienced analyst.
It rained for three days in a row.
We won five matches in a row.
The lamp lit up the whole room.
The journalist shed light on the whole case.
He picked a number at random.
The questions were chosen at random.
The school fights against racism.
Racism is still a big problem.
It was an exhausting day.
The job is draining and boring.
You have to chew your food well.
We're not allowed to chew gum in class.
My spine hurts from sitting.
The doctor is examining the spine.

note: Colloquial: «зеза ме кичма» - my back is acting up.

examples.en: The opposition left the session.
He has been in opposition for ten years.
The doctor says he is a sociopath.
A sociopath feels no guilt.
The vaccine protects against hepatitis.
He caught hepatitis on a trip.
The evacuation of the building began.
The evacuation went without any injuries.
We missed the turn for Novi Sad.
Turning left is prohibited here.
The match is at the city stadium.
The stadium was completely full.
Boarding starts at eight o'clock.
She came to the gate for boarding.
Oh no, what do we do now?
Oh dear, I lost my phone!

note: Often theatrical or humorous; «куку мајко» - oh my goodness.

examples.en: Write the address on the back of the envelope.
The date is on the back of the photo.
I only use vegetable oils.
This is an herbal tea for coughs.
Renting out apartments is a good business.
Issuing a passport takes a week.

related.en: to issue, to rent out, to publish

examples.en: He believes in life after death.
The world beyond the grave is the subject of many stories.
Scientists are studying these birds.
I'm studying the history of the Balkans.

note: Means in-depth study; for studying a school subject use «учити».

examples.en: Mosquitoes carry malaria.
He caught malaria in Africa.

forms: докопам се, докопају се; impf. докопавати се

examples.en: I barely made it home.
The thief got hold of the money.

note: + gen.: «докопати се власти» - to seize power

examples.en: Their engagement party will be in May.
Only the closest people are invited to the engagement party.

note: Plural only.

examples.en: The executioner carried out the sentence.
The people hated the king's executioner.

examples.sr: Све што смо урадили било је [бе̏звредно].
examples.en: Everything we did turned out to be worthless.
He felt worthless.
She's learning to play the violin.
The sound of the violin calms me.
Such a racist joke is unacceptable.
Many athletes condemned the racist outburst.
You put your sweater on inside out.
He turned the picture upside down.
He agreed without hesitation.
His hesitation cost us dearly.

forms: мимоиђем се, мимоиђу се; impf. мимоилазити се

examples.en: The trains passed each other at the station.

examples.sr: Мислим да смо се [мимо̀ишли] у гужви.
examples.en: I think we missed each other in the crowd.
The water supply to the house has been cut off.
Check the gas supply before lighting it.
Syphilis is treated with antibiotics.
The doctor suspected syphilis.

examples.sr: Већ пет година [ста̀нујем] у Новом Саду.
examples.en: I've been living in Novi Sad for five years.
They live on the third floor.

note: Refers to a place of residence; «to live» in general is «живети».

examples.en: The light suddenly went out.
Everything came all at once.
The test results are encouraging.
He said a few encouraging words.
The ceiling height is three meters.
A chandelier hangs from the ceiling.

note: Colloquial; the standard word is «таваница».

examples.en: Locking the door is mandatory.
The car's central locking broke.
Installing the program takes five minutes.
The house has old electrical wiring.
Do I have to pay a deposit?
They returned my deposit after the move.
They fought against the fascists there.
The fascist was sentenced to death.
The candies are menthol-flavored.
Menthol cream cools the skin.
A catheter was inserted into the patient.
The catheter needs to be changed regularly.
The locomotive pulls ten cars.
An old steam locomotive is a museum exhibit.
That pair is inseparable.
The rowing pair won a medal.
A clot formed in the blood.
A clot can block an artery.
Someone hacked our website.
They tried to hack the bank's system.
I bought new running shoes.
He drives a racing car.
He is negligent in his work.
A careless driver caused the accident.

note: Takes «према» + dat.

examples.en: My neighbor is Chinese.
That Chinese man speaks excellent Serbian.
He won too easily.
Don't take it too lightly.
The road goes uphill to the village.
It's hard to ride a bike uphill.
My daughter-in-law is a doctor.
The mother-in-law and daughter-in-law get along well.

note: A son's or a brother's wife.

examples.en: Stick it on with glue.
I bought wood glue.
The criminal was caught at the border.
War criminals are being brought to trial.
She is the minister's adviser.

examples.sr: Наша [са̀ветница] за кадрове враћа се у понедељак.
examples.en: Our HR adviser returns on Monday.
The thief managed to outwit the police.
The fox outwitted the wolf.
Surprisingly, the train arrived on time.
The test was surprisingly easy.
There's a crumb of bread on the table.
Pick up the crumbs from the carpet.
He reacted touchily to criticism.
This issue has to be handled delicately.
Putting on a helmet is mandatory.
Stocking the shelves with goods takes a long time.
He is waiting calmly for the results.
They live peacefully in the countryside.
The carpenter is trimming a plank.
The workers are hewing stone for the wall.
The goalkeeper saved the first shot.
A nice shot from twenty meters.

examples.sr: Тај капут је сувише [та̏нак] за зиму.
examples.en: That coat is too thin for winter.
He has a thin voice.

note: Of objects and voices; for a person use «мршав».

examples.en: It's comforting to know that we're not alone.

examples.sr: Мајка му је [утѐшно] рекла да ће све бити добро.
examples.en: His mother told him reassuringly that everything would be fine.
He acted unwisely.
It isn't foolish to ask for help.
The situation has changed radically.
He flatly rejects any compromise.
We saw a deer in the forest.
The male deer has antlers.
She bought a black thong for the beach.

examples.sr: У излогу су биле само [та̏нге] и грудњаци.
examples.en: The shop window had only thongs and bras.

examples.sr: Цео дан се чуло [ви́ка̄ње] са улице.
examples.en: Shouting could be heard from the street all day.
I'm sick of your yelling!

meanings: to get at, to aim at

examples.en: What are you getting at with this question?
He is up to something bad.

note: Colloquial; mostly in the sense «to be up to something».

examples.en: This plan is entirely feasible.
It isn't feasible to finish everything by Friday.
He felt humiliated in front of everyone.
You don't forget a humiliation like that.
I bought cough syrup.
The child takes the syrup three times a day.
Kids don't like peas.
There are peas in the salad too.
The journalist asked the minister about prices.
My sister works as a journalist.
The drug speeds up blood flow in the legs.
The poison entered the bloodstream.

examples.sr: Отворио сам [тѝкет] за проблем са сервером.
examples.en: I opened a ticket for the server problem.
Keep your ticket until the end of the ride.

note: Colloquial, from English; an ordinary ticket is «карта».

examples.en: This is my fiancée Ana.

examples.sr: Дошао је на свадбу са својом [за̀ручницом].
examples.en: He came to the wedding with his fiancée.
We're short on time.
The store has a shortage of bread.
He gets along with his stepfather.

examples.sr: Мој [о̏чӯх] ме је научио да возим.
examples.en: My stepfather taught me to drive.
I have to unclog the drain in the bathtub.
Clear your throat before the speech.

examples.sr: Написао ми је број на малом [лѝстићу].
examples.en: He wrote the number for me on a small slip of paper.
I filled out a lottery ticket.
Most of the texts remained untranslated.
This is an untranslated novel.
Her dancing delighted all the guests.
Dancing is my favorite pastime.
The tooth was removed painlessly.
The divorce went fairly painlessly.
This plant has a deep root.
The root of the word does not change.
The bed is behind the screen.
We bought a wooden screen.
The lioness protects her offspring.
They wanted to leave descendants.
The doctor prescribed me a mild sedative.
The sedative makes me sleepy.
He is an only child.
As an only child, he was very spoiled.

note: The feminine «јединица» is also the word for «unit; the number one».

examples.en: The pharmacy is open around the clock.
They worked day and night to finish the project.
A piglet will be slaughtered in the village tomorrow.
The war brought the slaughter of the innocent.
I want a waffle with chocolate.

examples.sr: За доручак смо јели [ва̏фле] са џемом.
examples.en: We had waffles with jam for breakfast.
His anger passed quickly.
He slammed the door in anger.
The light suddenly went out.
You can't do everything at once.
The state defends its territorial integrity.

examples.sr: Његов лични [интегрѝте̄т] нико не доводи у питање.
examples.en: Nobody questions his personal integrity.
We live on the ground floor.
The bakery is on the ground floor of the building.

note: «у приземљу» - on the ground floor

examples.en: At night I heard knocking at the door.
The pounding of his heart grew stronger.
He is quiet and reserved.
The door is closed.
We're looking for cheap lodging in town.
The shelter served the hikers as a place to spend the night.

examples.sr: Ова колекција се продаје [е̏ксклузӣвно] у нашој радњи.
examples.en: This collection is sold exclusively in our store.
The interview is exclusively for our paper.
The proposal was adopted unanimously.
The jury unanimously chose the winner.
The car became a real fetish for him.
The tribe kept an ancient fetish.
After that turn you'll see the house.
The country's policy made a sharp turn.

examples.sr: Био је уморан, а [у̀сто̄] и гладан.
examples.en: He was tired and, on top of that, hungry.
She's beautiful and smart besides.

note: Colloquial; «уз то» is more common.

examples.en: I spread butter on bread.

examples.sr: Колач се прави од [ма̀слаца] и шећера.
examples.en: The cake is made from butter and sugar.

note: In Serbia «путер» is more common.

examples.en: The body was covered with a white shroud.

examples.sr: Под [по̀кровом] ноћи изашли су из града.
examples.en: They left the city under cover of night.
Grandpa plays lotto every Sunday.

examples.sr: Деца воле да играју [ло̀то] за столом.
examples.en: Children like to play lotto at the table.
He doesn't like the smell of tobacco.
Tobacco is grown in Serbia.

examples.sr: Не желим да ме [упѐтљаш] у своје проблеме.
examples.en: I don't want you to drag me into your problems.
The thread got tangled into a knot.
There once lived a man called Žika.
I don't trust such so-called friends.

note: Past participle of «звати»; «тако звани» means so-called.

examples.sr: Компанија је пропала и све је у [ра̀сулу].
examples.en: The company went bankrupt and everything is in disarray.

examples.sr: После земљотреса град је био у [ра̀сулу].
examples.en: After the earthquake the city was in ruins.

note: Usually in the phrase «у расулу».

examples.en: The child likes cat food.
The meowing of a cat came from the room.
The state secured funding for the project.
We are looking for new sources of funding.

examples.sr: Позната [и̏зрека] каже: пиши као што говориш.
examples.en: A well-known saying goes: write as you speak.
Grandpa has a saying for every occasion.
The old mill stands by the river.
I grind coffee in a hand grinder.

note: For a water mill «воденица» is more common.

examples.en: She is a very determined girl.
He was persistent and did not give up.

note: «тврдоглав» (stubborn) is more often negative.

examples.en: You can hear an owl at night.
The owl is a symbol of wisdom.
My brother is a professional swimmer.
The best swimmer won the gold medal.
Visibility was poor because of the fog.
Visibility is reduced on the road.
Exercise helps me relax.
The doctor recommends daily exercise.
The price varies depending on the size.
We'll decide depending on the weather.

note: Used with «од» + gen.: «зависно од цене».

examples.en: I like fruit, especially apples.
Everyone is happy, especially the children.
The whole country remembers his feat.
Swimming across the river was a real feat.
A bee stung me on the hand.
Don't prick yourself with the needle.
The employees were issued new laptops.

examples.sr: Шеф ме је [задужѝо] за јавне набавке.
examples.en: The boss put me in charge of public procurement.

note: «бити задужен за» - to be responsible for

examples.en: Tonight we'll have salmon with vegetables.
Salmon is rich in healthy fats.

examples.sr: Он воли да [оку̀пља] пријатеље око стола.
examples.en: He likes to gather his friends around the table.
In the evening we gather at the tavern.

note: «окупљати се» - to gather (oneself)

examples.en: The mother guards her cub.
There are a lot of young animals on the farm.

note: Many animals have no word of their own: a bear cub is «младунче медведа».

examples.en: Turn on the GPS, we're lost.
The ship has an experienced navigator.
My niece is in first grade.
I bought a gift for my niece.
He is passionate about soccer.
The couple kissed passionately.
The court rejected the defense's motion on evidence.
The police gathered the evidence.

note: Bookish, a legal term.

examples.en: Burning trash in the forest is prohibited.
History remembers the burning of books.
The old woman smiled a toothless smile.
Grandma has no teeth left.
He has always been a rebel.
The army arrested the leader of the rebels.

examples.sr: Лекар ми је рекао да [огра̀ничим] со.
examples.en: The doctor told me to limit salt.
The city wants to limit the speed.

examples.sr: Као [дезѐрте̄р] био је осуђен на затвор.
examples.en: As a deserter, he was sentenced to prison.
Many deserters fled across the border.

examples.sr: [Ка̀њо̄н] Таре је један од најдубљих у Европи.
examples.en: The Tara canyon is one of the deepest in Europe.
The hikers went down into the canyon.
A big haystack stands in the field.
Below there is a seam of coal.
Parents rarely punish their children.
The law punishes theft.

examples.sr: Његово [сви́ра̄ње] на гитари одушевило је публику.
examples.en: His guitar playing delighted the audience.
The neighbors complain about the playing at night.
I'm sending you a postcard from the seaside.
I collect postcards from different countries.
Nothing can get past him.
The ball slipped past the post.
The drug is in the clinical trial phase.
The doctors declared clinical death.
The school puts on a play every year.
They often throw parties for their friends.
Slice the bread thin.
The dough has to be rolled out thin.

note: Figuratively, things are tight: «танко нам је».

examples.en: The painter stretched the canvas.
The film looks better on the big screen.
The cellar reeks of mold.
His socks make the whole apartment stink.

note: Takes «на» + acc.: «заудара на дим» - it reeks of smoke.

examples.en: The dog barked furiously at the stranger.
He slammed the door in a rage.
Skin needs daily care.
The mother devoted a lot of care to the child.

note: «нега лица» - facial care; also nursing care.

examples.en: I bought a new red lipstick.
A lipstick mark was left on the glass.
Close the water valve.
The valve on the tire is leaking.
This shot is unusually beautiful.
The director changed the shot.

examples.sr: Брз [метаболѝзам] ми помаже да не дебљам.
examples.en: A fast metabolism helps me not gain weight.
Metabolism slows down with age.
A painting of the Madonna hangs in the church.
Raphael painted many Madonnas.
I buy meat from the same butcher.
This butcher makes excellent sausages.

note: Colloquial; the standard word is «месар». Also figuratively a brute.

examples.en: The ship dropped anchor.
They raised the anchor at dawn.
Do up your jacket, it's cold.
He couldn't fasten his tight jeans.
Their respect is mutual.
They mutually agreed to help one another.
He brought her a big bouquet of roses.
This bouquet is a beautiful gift.

examples.sr: Дечак је помогао [слѐпцу] да пређе улицу.
examples.en: The boy helped a blind man cross the street.
The blind man read with his fingers.
His optimism cheered us all up.
I look at the future with optimism.
